source_refs.note: 3. Enzyme Concentration: a main subheading of 5.4 Factors affecting the rate of enzyme action, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 135-136.

blocks.text: Enzymes bohat kaar-aamad (efficient) hain; enzyme ke thore se molecules bhi substrate ki bari miqdar ke reactions chala sakte hain. Agar substrate bohat zyada ho to enzyme wale reaction ki kul raftar seedhi us waqt maujood enzyme ki miqdar par munhasir hoti hai. Jab enzyme ki concentration barhti hai to zyada enzyme molecules aur zyada active sites hoti hain, is liye zyada substrate molecules nayi active sites se jur kar products bante hain. Lekin agar enzyme barhta jaye aur substrate utna hi rahe to mazeed substrate molecules jurne ke liye nahin bachte; is liye raftar ek jaisi (constant) reh jati hai aur aage nahin barhti (Fig. 5.7).

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur enzyme ki concentration ka graph. Lakeer origin se seedhi barhti hai, phir mur kar ek nuqtedar satah ke saath seedhi (flat) chalti hai; mor par teer ke saath likha hai No more substrate to attach with enzyme.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Enzyme ki concentration ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab tak substrate wafir hai, zyada enzyme ka matlab zyada active sites aur zyada raftar, is liye lakeer seedhi barhti hai. Mor ke baad tamam substrate pehle hi enzymes se jura hua hai; mazeed enzyme ke liye substrate nahin bacha, is liye raftar barabar (constant) rehti hai.
